punchline: Simon Sinek sat through two rival summits: at one the talks were about beating Apple, at the other about helping teachers.
thirty_sec: Simon Sinek was invited to speak at both Microsoft's and Apple's education summits. At Microsoft the presenters kept coming back to beating Apple. At Apple they talked about helping teachers teach. Sinek read it as two mindsets. His term for the useful kind of competitor is a worthy rival: someone better than you at something, who shows you where to improve.
